entries.name: wood elf
entries.content: Wood elves: They are often associated with nature and the forest. They are generally described as graceful and agile beings, with a great knowledge of flora and fauna.

entries.name: moon elf
entries.content: Moon elves or gray elves: They are often associated with magic and the moon. They are generally described as mysterious and wise beings, with great knowledge of magic and the arts.

entries.name: dark elf
entries.content: Dark elves or drow: They are often associated with malice and darkness. They are generally described as cruel and manipulative beings, with great knowledge of dark magic.

entries.name: water elf
entries.content: Aquatic elves or merfolk: They are often associated with water and the sea. They are generally described as graceful and elegant beings, with great knowledge of the sea and its secrets.

entries.name: star elf
entries.content: Star elves or mithril elves: They are often associated with the stars and the sky. They are generally described as mysterious and ethereal beings, with great knowledge of astronomy and magic.

entries.name: swamp elf
entries.content: Swamp elves: They are often associated with swamps and wetlands. They are generally described as aggressive beings and unpopular with other peoples.

entries.name: harbour elf
entries.content: Haven elves: They are often associated with the sea and ports. They are generally described as tradesmen and skilled beings, with great knowledge of trade and navigation.

entries.name: river elf
entries.content: River elves: They are often associated with rivers and streams. They are generally described as peaceful and wise beings, with great knowledge of nature and aquatic life.

entries.name: ice elf
entries.content: Ice elves: They are often associated with cold and snowy regions. They are generally described as resistant and enduring beings, with great knowledge of survival in hostile environments.

entries.name: desert elf
entries.content: Desert elves: They are often associated with arid and desert regions. They are generally described as nomadic and free beings, with great knowledge of survival in hostile environments.

entries.name: high elf
entries.content:
The High Elves, also known as the Asur in Eltharin, are a species of elves noted for their great wisdom and long history. They are considered an ancient people, whose chronicles date back to times when the world was still young
The High Elves are dexterous, lively and noble, which highlights the barbarity of other peoples in their eyes
The High Elves are adults at 80 years old, and their reproductive functions begin at age 50. Before this age they are considered juveniles and children.

entries.name: currencies
entries.content:
The currencies used on the main continent are: copper coins, silver coins, gold coins and mithril ingots. Gemstones are not considered currencies but items to upgrade weapons and armor.
The least important currency is the copper coin.
1 silver coin = 10 copper coins
1 gold coin = 10 silver coins
1 mithril ingot = 50 copper coins gold
price example:
1 pint of ale = 1 copper coin
1 steel dagger = 2 silver coins
1 house slave = 6 gold coins
1 short sword of fire (magic) = 20 coins gold
1 war slave = 40 gold
1 slave educated from birth, price per year = 1 mithril ingot

entries.name: city loren
entries.content: Loren is the capital of Cyrte County. We are outside the lands of {{user}}. The population is 41,000 people, making it the most populated in the surrounding area. Among the many stores, There are shops, restaurants, blacksmiths and other sellers of magical items. There is also the Adventurers' Guild to the south of the town. Forests surround Loren, making it a town often attacked by isolated elves and goblins .

The main continent was once populated mainly by elves, but humans have invaded the majority of the continent. This continent is made up of 5 counties: grimor ruled by {{user}} is the center of the religion of daemion, cyrte where the capital loren and the adventurers guild are located, Majar where the dwarves and the mithril deposits are located, Jahare where are the greatest mages and the magicians' guild and it is the most remote county, still largely populated by centaurs.
